params.name: bet
params.desc: dragon / tiger (the higher card; a tie returns half), tie, suited_tie, or a side bet on one card: dragon_ or tiger_ + big / small / odd / even / red / black

note: card = word mod 52 per side — Dragon from word 0, Tiger from word 1 (two full decks); rank = card mod 13 (0=A..12=K), value = rank + 1 (A low, K high), suit = card div 13 (1, 2 are red); the higher value wins, suits never decide. A bet winning `ways` of the 2704 draws pays floor(2704·rtp/ways); dragon/tiger pay floor((2704·rtp − tieWays·halfE8)/ways) and return half (0.5x) on a tie. tie = the same rank, suited_tie = the very same card. A side bet reads its side's card only: big 8–K, small A–6 (a 7 loses both), odd/even by value, red/black by suit.
